```{r}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Simulate 5 independent realizations of:
## X_t = a X_{t-1} + b + e_t,  e_t ~ N(0, sigma1^2)
## ------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(42)   # Reproducibility

## Parameters
a <- 0.9
b <- 1
sigma1 <- 1
X0 <- 5

n <- 100
n_sim <- 5

## Matrix for saving trajectories
## Rows = time points 0,...,100
## Columns = independent simulations
X <- matrix(NA, nrow = n + 1, ncol = n_sim)

## Initial value
X[1, ] <- X0

## Simulation
for (j in 1:n_sim) {
  for (t in 2:(n + 1)) {
    e_t <- rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = sigma1)
    X[t, j] <- a * X[t - 1, j] + b + e_t
  }
}

## Time index
time <- 0:n

## Plot all 5 trajectories
matplot(
  time, X,
  type = "l",
  lty = 1,
  lwd = 2,
  col = 1:n_sim,
  xlab = "Time step",
  ylab = expression(X[t]),
  main = "Five Independent Realizations of the Process"
)

legend(
  "bottomright",
  legend = paste("Trajectory", 1:n_sim),
  col = 1:n_sim,
  lty = 1,
  lwd = 2
)
```
# Exercise 1.2
```{r}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Simulate one realization of the state-space model:
##
## X_t = a X_{t-1} + b + e1_t,   e1_t ~ N(0, sigma1^2)
## Y_t = X_t + e2_t,             e2_t ~ N(0, sigma2^2)
## ------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(42)   # Reproducibility

## Parameters
a <- 0.9
b <- 1
sigma1 <- 1
sigma2 <- 1
X0 <- 5

n <- 100

## Vectors for saving latent states and observations
X <- rep(NA, n + 1)
Y <- rep(NA, n + 1)

## Initial state
X[1] <- X0

## Simulate observation at time 0
Y[1] <- X[1] + rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = sigma2)

## Simulate process and observations
for (t in 2:(n + 1)) {
  e1_t <- rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = sigma1)
  e2_t <- rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = sigma2)
  
  X[t] <- a * X[t - 1] + b + e1_t
  Y[t] <- X[t] + e2_t
}

## Time index
time <- 0:n

## Plot latent state and noisy observations
plot(
  time, X,
  type = "l",
  lwd = 2,
  col = "blue",
  xlab = "Time step",
  ylab = "Value",
  main = expression("Latent state " * X[t] * " and noisy observations " * Y[t])
)

points(
  time, Y,
  col = "red",
  pch = 16
)

lines(
  time, Y,
  col = "red",
  lty = 2
)

legend(
  "bottomright",
  legend = c("True latent state X_t", "Noisy observations Y_t"),
  col = c("blue", "red"),
  lty = c(1, 2),
  pch = c(NA, 16),
  lwd = c(2, 1)
)
```

```{r}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Kalman filter for scalar state-space model:
##
## X_t = a X_{t-1} + b + e1_t,   e1_t ~ N(0, sigma1^2)
## Y_t = X_t + e2_t,             e2_t ~ N(0, R)
##
## Here C = 1, so no matrix operations are needed.
## ------------------------------------------------------------

myKalmanFilter <- function(
  y,              # Vector of observations Y_t
  theta,          # theta = c(a, b, sigma1)
  R,              # Measurement noise variance sigma2^2
  x_prior = 0,    # Initial prior mean for X_0
  P_prior = 10    # Initial prior variance for X_0
) {
  a <- theta[1]
  b <- theta[2]
  sigma1 <- theta[3]
  
  Q <- sigma1^2   # Process noise variance
  
  N <- length(y)
  
  x_pred <- numeric(N)         # Predicted state mean
  P_pred <- numeric(N)         # Predicted state variance
  
  x_filt <- numeric(N)         # Filtered state mean
  P_filt <- numeric(N)         # Filtered state variance
  
  innovation <- numeric(N)     # y_t - predicted y_t
  innovation_var <- numeric(N) # Var(y_t | past)
  
  for (t in seq_len(N)) {
    
    ## -------------------------
    ## Prediction step
    ## -------------------------
    if (t == 1) {
      x_pred[t] <- a * x_prior + b
      P_pred[t] <- a^2 * P_prior + Q
    } else {
      x_pred[t] <- a * x_filt[t - 1] + b
      P_pred[t] <- a^2 * P_filt[t - 1] + Q
    }
    
    
    ## -------------------------
    ## Update step
    ## -------------------------
    innovation[t] <- y[t] - x_pred[t]
    innovation_var[t] <- P_pred[t] + R
    
    K_t <- P_pred[t] / innovation_var[t]
    
    x_filt[t] <- x_pred[t] + K_t * innovation[t]
    P_filt[t] <- P_pred[t] - K_t * innovation_var[t] * K_t
    
    ## Equivalent scalar formula:
    ## P_filt[t] <- (1 - K_t) * P_pred[t]
  }
  
  return(list(
    x_pred = x_pred,
    P_pred = P_pred,
    x_filt = x_filt,
    P_filt = P_filt,
    innovation = innovation,
    innovation_var = innovation_var
  ))
}
```

```{r}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Simulate one realization
## ------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(42)

a <- 0.9
b <- 1
sigma1 <- 1
sigma2 <- 1

R <- sigma2^2
X0 <- 5
n <- 100

X <- rep(NA, n + 1)
Y <- rep(NA, n + 1)

X[1] <- X0
Y[1] <- X[1] + rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = sigma2)

for (t in 2:(n + 1)) {
  e1_t <- rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = sigma1)
  e2_t <- rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = sigma2)
  
  X[t] <- a * X[t - 1] + b + e1_t
  Y[t] <- X[t] + e2_t
}

time <- 0:n
```


```{r}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Apply Kalman filter
## ------------------------------------------------------------

theta <- c(a, b, sigma1)

kf <- myKalmanFilter(
  y = Y,
  theta = theta,
  R = R,
  x_prior = 5,
  P_prior = 0
)


```

```{r}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 95% confidence interval for predicted state
## ------------------------------------------------------------

upper <- kf$x_pred + 1.96 * sqrt(kf$P_pred)
lower <- kf$x_pred - 1.96 * sqrt(kf$P_pred)

ylim_range <- range(c(X, Y, lower, upper), na.rm = TRUE)

plot(
  time, X,
  type = "l",
  lwd = 2,
  col = "blue",
  ylim = ylim_range,
  xlab = "Time step",
  ylab = "Value",
  main = expression("Kalman filtre")
)

## Add confidence interval
lines(time, upper, col = "darkgreen", lty = 3, lwd = 1.5)
lines(time, lower, col = "darkgreen", lty = 3, lwd = 1.5)

## Add observations
points(time, Y, col = "red", pch = 16, cex = 0.7)

## Add predicted state
lines(time, kf$x_pred, col = "darkgreen", lty = 2, lwd = 2)

legend(
  "bottomright",
  legend = c(
    "True latent state X_t",
    "Noisy observations Y_t",
    "Predicted state",
    "95% prediction interval"
  ),
  col = c("blue", "red", "darkgreen", "darkgreen"),
  lty = c(1, NA, 2, 3),
  pch = c(NA, 16, NA, NA),
  lwd = c(2, NA, 2, 1.5),
  bty = "n"
)
```


# Exercise 1.4


```{r}
myLogLikFun <- function(theta, y, R, x_prior = 0, P_prior = 10) {
  a <- theta[1]
  b <- theta[2]
  sigma1 <- theta[3]
  
  # Optional: prevent invalid standard deviations
  if (sigma1 <= 0) {
    return(Inf)
  }
  
  # Call the Kalman filter function
  kf_result <- myKalmanFilter(
    y = y,
    theta = theta,
    R = R,
    x_prior = x_prior,
    P_prior = P_prior
  )
  err <- kf_result$innovation        # v_t = y_t - y_hat_t
  S <- kf_result$innovation_var      # S_t = Var(v_t)
  
  # Log-likelihood for Gaussian innovations
  logL <- sum(
    -0.5 * (
      log(2 * pi) +
      log(S) +
      (err^2 / S)
    )
  )
  
  return(-logL)  # negative log-likelihood for minimization
}
```


```{r}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Simulate scalar state-space model
##
## X_t = a X_{t-1} + b + e1_t,   e1_t ~ N(0, sigma1^2)
## Y_t = X_t + e2_t,             e2_t ~ N(0, R)
## ------------------------------------------------------------

simulateSystem <- function(
  n,
  theta,
  R,
  x0 = 0
) {
  a <- theta[1]
  b <- theta[2]
  sigma1 <- theta[3]
  
  x <- numeric(n)
  y <- numeric(n)
  
  x[1] <- a * x0 + b + rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = sigma1)
  y[1] <- x[1] + rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(R))
  
  for (t in 2:n) {
    x[t] <- a * x[t - 1] + b + rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = sigma1)
    y[t] <- x[t] + rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(R))
  }
  
  return(list(
    x = x,
    y = y
  ))
}
```

```{r}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Estimate parameters from 100 independent simulations
## ------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(123)

n <- 100
n_sim <- 100

theta_true <- c(0.9, 1, 5)
names(theta_true) <- c("a", "b", "sigma1")

R <- 1   # known measurement noise variance

estimates <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_sim, ncol = 3)
colnames(estimates) <- c("a_hat", "b_hat", "sigma1_hat")

convergence <- numeric(n_sim)

for (i in seq_len(n_sim)) {
  
  sim <- simulateSystem(
    n = n,
    theta = theta_true,
    R = R,
    x0 = 0
  )
  
  fit <- optim(
    par = c(0.5, 0.5, 0.5),
    fn = myLogLikFun,
    y = sim$y,
    R = R,
    method = "L-BFGS-B",
    lower = c(-0.999, -Inf, 1e-6),
    upper = c(0.999, Inf, Inf)
  )
  
  estimates[i, ] <- fit$par
  convergence[i] <- fit$convergence
}

estimates <- as.data.frame(estimates)

head(estimates)
```

```{r}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Numerical summary
## ------------------------------------------------------------

summary_results <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("a", "b", "sigma1"),
  True_value = theta_true,
  Mean_estimate = colMeans(estimates),
  Median_estimate = apply(estimates, 2, median),
  SD_estimate = apply(estimates, 2, sd),
  Bias = colMeans(estimates) - theta_true
)

print(summary_results)

cat("Number of failed optimizations:", sum(convergence != 0), "\n")
```

```{r}

)

)
```
